Institutional Compliance & Transparency

Clear Contracts, Transparent GST & Total Protection

One of the biggest concerns for property owners is: "How does the lease work if the tenant signs with Croww, and how are taxes and GST handled?" Here is our straightforward legal blueprint:

🛡️ Master Tenancy Agreement

The property owner executes an institutional Master Lease with Croww Technologies. The end-tenant enters into a legally vetted sub-tenancy agreement with Croww. This shields the owner from tenant disputes, non-payment, or eviction friction.

📑 GST on Residential Renting

Under Indian GST provisions, renting of residential dwellings for use as residence to unregistered persons is exempt. For corporate or registered entities, reverse charge (RCM) applies. Croww’s legal and tax framework ensures owners have zero unexpected tax liabilities.

Frequently Asked Questions

When will Croww launch publicly? +

We are launching our private pilot in Q1 2027 starting with an initial cohort of 10 curated buildings across Bengaluru and Chennai. Waitlist members get early access to book homes or submit properties.

How does the 5-to-10 Year Capital Lease guarantee my capital back? +

The agreement is backed by registered lease deed contracts. At the conclusion of the 5 or 10-year term, Croww returns the agreed capital principal to the owner, while the owner retains full title and capital appreciation.

Can normal owners list without partnering with Croww? +

Yes! Any individual owner can post standard rental and sale listings directly on the map. You can optionally upgrade anytime to Croww Managed or Furnished packages.
